name: Tokita Kaede
source:
A student that transfers in week 2. He is still getting used to new life around campus and is often seen with Yurika. He has long purple hair and wears glasses. He is known to do flower arrangement.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Otometeki_Koi_Kakumei_Love_Revo!!#Male_Characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
